tail:
Completed the batch-17 draft pair: the A page proves the finite-alphabet Wyner–Ziv theorem and a Berger–Tung inner bound; the B page covers no-side-information, lossless, and Slepian–Wolf special cases. It makes no exact general multiterminal claim.

**Scoped checks pass:** 11 proof items, 41 steps, 0 proof-layout defects; precheck 11/11; rendercheck 13/13; strict proof contracts 11/11; source harvest 30 results with no errors or warnings; source-fetch check 4/4. The batch-17 item dependency graph has no level mismatches, cycles, or manifest/header differences. Four full-text treatments are recorded: the [Wyner–Ziv paper](https://web.mit.edu/6.962/www/www_fall_2001/kusuma/wynerziv.pdf), [El Gamal–Kim notes](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1001.3404v3), [Barros dissertation](https://mediatum.ub.tum.de/doc/601579/601579.pdf), and [Cover–Thomas](https://pages.hmc.edu/ruye/book2/ElementsofInformationTheory.pdf).

**Artifacts:** [A page](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/information-theory/lossy-source-coding-with-side-information.md>), [B page](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/library/information-theory/lossy-source-coding-with-side-information-examples.md>), [batch manifest](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-17.pages.json>), [source coverage](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-17.source-coverage.json>), [proof contracts](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-17.proof-contracts.json>), [cross-batch checks](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-17.cross-batch-dependencies.json>), and [batch notes](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/non-ml-math-remaining-81-2026-10-18-batch-17.notes.md>).

**Owner follow-up:** The registered `plan-spec.json` summary omits the track prose’s no-rate-loss criterion and exact Gaussian two-encoder region; I recorded that scope conflict for reconciliation. All 14 Step 1 records are `ready`, but the run-wide check is blocked by the unrelated noncanonical root item `thm-it-dmc-uniform-quadratic-capacity-decay`. Run-wide dependency checks also hit unrelated empty inventories, a duplicate/cyclic item, and six malformed batch-19 source-title entries.
